title: Integral quotient fibre identifies with closed fibre
statement:
theorem closed_fibre_is_integral
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [ValuationRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hX₀ : IsIntegral (Limits.pullback f (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)))))) :
    IsIntegral (f.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A))

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 0EX8, general-case proof

proof.text: The residue-field presentation of the closed point is canonically the quotient A/m; pulling it back along f identifies the two fibres.

proof_origin.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 0EX8, general-case proof
